items.text: Selection methods · Fetchers · Spiders · Proxy Rotation · CLI · MCP Scrapling is a Python Web Scraping framework that brings fast HTTP requests, stealth browsers, powerful parsing, and concurrent crawling into one library. Scrape static pages, render JavaScript, interact with websites, and extract data from the API calls behind them. Build crawlers with reusable sessions, proxy rotation, automatic retries, pause/resume, and built-in data exports. Use it from Python, the terminal, or your AI agent through its MCP server and Agent Skill. From extracting a few fields to collecting a whole website as clean Markdown, Scrapling covers the full scraping workflow. - Fetch & interact: Fast HTTP requests, stealth browsers, JavaScript rendering, Cloudflare Turnstile/Interstitial handling, persistent sessions, and background API capture. - Parse & extract: CSS, XPath, text and regex search, adaptive element tracking, similar-element matching, and clean Markdown output. - Crawl & export: Concurrent spiders, proxy rotation, retries, AutoThrottle, pause/resume, streaming, ready-made templates, and JSON/JSONL/CSV/XML exports. - Scrape with AI or from your terminal: An MCP server for AI agents to browse and extract data, an Agent Skill, CLI commands, and an interactive shell. Start with a single page: from scrapling.fetchers import Fetcher page = Fetcher.get('https://quotes.toscrape.com/') quotes = page.css('.quote .text::text').getall() print(quotes) Or scale up with a spider: from scrapling.spiders import Spider, Response class QuotesSpider(Spider): name = "quotes" start_urls = ["https://quotes.toscrape.com/"] async def parse(self, response: Response): for quote in response.css('.quote'): yield { "text": quote.css('.text::text').get(), "author": quote.css('.author::text').get(), } res...

items.text: 让 AI Agent 够得着它自己上不去的互联网 登录墙后的平台、视频里的内容、中文平台、干净的结构化数据，一条命令拿到 💬 有问题、想要新平台、或者想看看别人怎么用？来 Discord 聊聊。 点击展开 Agent Reach 让你的 Agent 真正连上互联网，用上它自己够不着的平台和能力。 Claude Code、Codex、Hermes Agent、OpenClaw 这类 CLI Agent 自带搜索和网页读取，但下面这些它们基本够不着： - 要登录才能用的功能：在小红书搜笔记、在 X 查账号动态、读职位详情等。 - 视频里的内容：B站和 YouTube 的字幕，以及 YouTube 视频、小宇宙播客的语音转文字。 - 中文平台：B站、小红书、V2EX、雪球，通用搜索覆盖很差。 - 干净的结构化数据：雪球行情、V2EX 帖子和回复、GitHub 仓库和 issue，拿到的是整理好的内容。 Agent Reach 把这些平台背后的工具替你装好、测好，Agent 一条命令就能用： agent-reach channels # 有哪些渠道、每个渠道能做什么 agent-reach bilibili search "大模型" # agent-reach [参数] agent-reach read https://www.v2ex.com/t/123 # 按链接自动选渠道 - 适用于哪些 Agent？ 一切 Agent 都能用。 - 会碰我的浏览器和账号吗？ 要登录的平台用 Agent Reach 自己的专用浏览器，在后台运行、不弹窗。第一次用某个网站时，会把你 Chrome 里这个网站的登录复制一份过去，原浏览器不变，不读密码库。复制过来的通常是主账号，建议换成小号，做法见下面的"安全性"。详见会话配置。 下表是当前版本的情况。 - 默认：装好就能用；不想要也可以去掉，以后更新不会再加回来。 - 可选：说一句"帮我加上 XX"就开启，需要的软件会自动装好。 - 实验：能用，但平台反爬更严，可能随时失效。 把这句话发给你的 Agent： 帮我安装 Agent Reach：https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Panniantong/Agent-Reach/main/docs/install.md 无论是安装还是升级，都只需要这一条命令就行了。 剩下的 Agent 自己做完。过程中你可能会被问到： - 允许它执行命令：如果 Agent 说自己不能运行命令，去它的设置里打开"允许执行命令"。 - 装 uv：uv 是一个安装命令行程序的小工具，不需要管理员密码。电脑上没有的话 Agent 会先装它，会跟你说一声。 - 要不要加可选渠道：装完后 Agent 会告诉你哪些已经能用（B站、V2EX、GitHub、YouTube、网页），以及还能加哪些。你选了再加，也可以以后随时说"帮我加上小红书"，一条命令就装好。 关于登录：部分平台会直接复用你电脑上已有的登录。想换成某个特定账号（比如小号），跟 Agent 说一声就行。Agent 从不替你登录，也不会要你的密码。 ⚠️ PyPI 上叫agent-reach 的包不是本项目，请勿从 PyPI 安装，只用 install.md 里的 GitHub 地址。 Agent Reach 装的所有东西（各渠道的工具、登录、设置）都放在你电脑上同一个文件夹里（~/.agent-reach/ ），不散落到别处。所以升级、管理、删除都很省事，一句话就行。 直接用大白话跟 Agent 说： 出了问题，Agent 会告诉你是哪个平台、什么原因、下一步怎么做。常见问题见 troubleshooting.md。 每个平台的每个动作都有一个按顺序尝试的工具列表。比如读 B站视频先用 bili-cli，失败了自动换 B站公开接口；读网页先用 Jina Reader，再用 Exa。 flowchart LR A[Agent] -->|agent-reach 渠道 动作| B[Agent Reach] B --> C{按顺序尝试} C -->|首选| D[上游工具 1] C -->|失败时备选| E[上游工具 2] D --> F[结果] E --> F F --> A 平台改版、工具失效是常态。换工...

items.summary: Release: llm 0.37 There's a lot of stuff in this new release of my LLM CLI tool and Python library, representing around two months of accumulated features and fixes. I added gpt-6.1-sol and gpt-6.1-terra , plus a new llm openai endpoint add command to make it easier to configure additional models that use OpenAI-compatible endpoints. I switched the default model (if you have not set your own default) to gpt-6-luna - half the price of the previous default, gpt-5.6-luna . LLM's support for embeddings now accepts that different binary content may have different content-type - necessary for models like Gemini Embedding 2 , which can embed text, audio, images, and video. A lot of open source maintainers complain about a flood of AI-assisted PRs. LLM is my project that has been most affected by this and, to be honest, I'm not finding it to be a problem. This release includes fixes from 12 authors - almost all AI-assisted - and the burden of reviewing them wasn't nearly as great as I expected. items.summary: Discover how ChatGPT and Codex are helping engineers accelerate CAD, PCB design, simulation, and other workflows across the physical world.
items.text: Today, we’re sharing advances in how OpenAI models help engineers design, simulate, and build physical products. These capabilities span mechanical and electrical engineering and end-to-end system design, and are already helping our internal teams test ideas and iterate faster. Across these projects, engineers need to bring together mechanical designs, electronics, software, and manufacturing requirements using specialized tools. We’re teaching models to support that work, from preparing drawings and setting up simulations to coordinating changes across disciplines. Our goal is to give engineers more time to explore ideas and improve designs. Over the past year, improved frontier model capabilities have helped our internal teams test new ideas and iterate faster, and we are seeing early evidence of these capabilities improving professional workflows in industry as well. We’re working with collaborators to understand where these capabilities can make the biggest difference and what needs to improve. If you’re an engineer, engineering firm, or software vendor involved in the design, simulation, manufacturing, or production of complex physical products, we’d love to work with you to shape this effort around the tools you use and the problems you need to solve. Designing a device with Astra We testedAstra’s state-of-the-art performance in multimodal and computer use workflows by seeing if we can create a device without any direct human edits. To do this, we used GPT‑6 to define the functional requirements and design the enclosure, printed circuit board (PCB), and software integrations needed to create a device users can use to talk to Codex. items.title: GitHub Universe 2026: Evolving every layer of the stack
items.summary: Today, we laid out our vision for GitHub as the most comprehensive, end-to-end software delivery system in the world. The post GitHub Universe 2026: Evolving every layer of the stack appeared first on The GitHub Blog .
items.text: Our jobs as developers are changing. In a couple of years, we’ve gone from writing every line of code to working with AI assistants to orchestrating fleets of agents. But the goal hasn’t changed: ship completed software work. A feature, a bug fix, a security fix. Completed work, not more code, is the output that matters. Today at GitHub Universe, we shared our vision for GitHub as the most comprehensive software delivery system in the world. We introduced products that bring that vision to life and showed how we’re rebuilding the infrastructure underneath it. Our vision: From idea to completed software The SDLC is no longer a linear path from planning to coding to testing to deployment. A code change, a request from a colleague, or a production metric can trigger work anywhere in the system. Most of us (and our agents) jump between different stages, depending on the task at hand. Developers set the direction, make decisions, and stay accountable for what ships. Agents implement and verify changes. And everything feeds into and out of a continuous learning machine that makes the next cycle better. This agentic software delivery system solves for three things: - Velocity: get from idea to completed software as quickly, efficiently, and cost-effectively as possible - Intelligence: combine context across the platform with a continuous learning engine, so the system gets better as you use it - Quality: make completed work secure by default and catch bugs before they ship GitHub is built for developers and their agents. We’re also making the underlying primitives available, so you can build your own bespoke solutions. You stay in control of the work, the tools, and the cost. items.title: Qwen 3.8 27B on my laptop can interpret model weights, too
items.summary: Yesterday's hot paper was Sparks of Weight-Space Programming: LLMs can natively read & write neural network weights by Rikiya Takehi, Jayden Teoh, Alex Zhang, and Omar Khattab. The paper (OK, the authors classify is as a "blog post", but it's paper-shaped) found that frontier models, in particular GPT-6 Astra, can both interpret and modify the raw weights of a machine learning model - literally a text description of the model containing a bunch of floating point numbers. I've been playing with one of the examples from the paper and I'm delighted to share that Qwen 3.8 27B running on my laptop can do this as well! Weight-Space Programming Here's the highlight from their abstract, describing impressive capabilities for GPT-6 Astra and coining the term Weight-Space Programming for when LLMs analyze and modify model weights: Just by looking at the raw weights, GPT-6 Astra can tell what a network was trained to do . And without any environment feedback, it has no trouble writing, from scratch, small game-playing networks that outplay networks trained with PPO for 100 million steps. items.title: Japan's Jimi 'Mundane' Halloween Costumes of 2026
items.summary: Comments
items.text: Happy Jimi Halloween to everyone who celebrates. It’s that wonderful time of year when our favorite Japanese festival, Jimi Halloween, is on full display. Mundane Halloween, as we coined it back in 2018, is when people dress up in costumes so mundane they have to be explained. The tradition was started in 2014 by a group of adults at Daily Portal Z who kind of wanted to participate in the festivities of Halloween, but were too embarrassed to go all out in witch or zombie costumes. So instead of the flashy and flamboyant costumes they had been seeing gain popularity in Japan, they decided to dress up in mundane, everyday costumes. You can comb through social media using the hashtag #地味ハロウィン but below we present to you some of our favorites from this year’s festivities. We’ve been covering this event since 2018 so you can also take a look at some past years too! Person trying to take a group photo in a very small izakaya | @YSSkywalker Person who is about to ask if it’s okay to push their seat back | @dailyportalz Person who can’t figure out how to turn on the designer faucet | @dailyportalz Person trying not to laugh on the train as they watch a funny video | @ai_okubo0617 Person who thought the muddler was a straw | @dailyportalz Person who didn’t expect to have to remove their shoes at the business dinner | @zukitomotomo An expert on a very niche subject | @ef510515hokuto3 Person who should definitely put some of their stuff in the backpack | @iwanttobeJinrui Woman replenishing her dispensers | @08Aikorian
